title: Text content that is null

source.note: composed: Annex A allows a null Content, so the message decodes; §5.1.4 requires the content to match the format, and `text` means a string, so validate reports an Error. Contrast ecma-430/10-missing-content, where the field is absent and the message does not decode at all.

notes: A missing `content` is an error while a null one is not, which is a fine distinction to hang on Annex A's informative schema. It is the only reading that lets Annex A's null mean anything.
